title: Yetkazish narxi normaga kiradimi?
caption: ❓ Savol: «Tovar 200 $ dan arzon. Nega boj so'rashdi?» Chunki normaga tovar narxi + yetkazish (yo'l) harajati birga hisoblanadi. 🧮 Ikki misol (kuryer, 2 kg, yo'l 19 $) • Kurtka 180 $ + 19 $ = 199 $ → norma ichida, boj yo'q ✅ • Kurtka 185 $ + 19 $ = 204 $ → 4 $ ortiq ❌ Boj: 4 × 30 % = 1,20 $ (≈ 14 277 so'm) + 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im 110 000 so'm Atigi 5 $ farq — to'lov esa 124 277 so'm. 💡 Qoida: do'kondagi narxni emas, «tovar + yetkazish» summasini 200 $ bilan solishtiring. Yetkazish narxini kuryer xizmatidan oldindan bilib oling. 📄 Asos: VM 244-son; PQ-4508, 3-band; VM 55-son — lex.uz 📲 Tovar + yetkazishni ilovada hisoblang ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #savol
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#savol".
2) Center: a price tag reading 185 $ and a small delivery-truck tag reading +19 $ hanging together from a cardboard parcel, both tied with one indigo string to a sign showing a thin line at 200 $. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of sky blue (#38BDF8); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Yetkazish narxi normaga kiradimi?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Tovar + yo'l = bojxona qiymati"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Bojxona qiymati = tovar + yetkazish — muallif tasdiqlagan qoida (05.10.2026); lex.uz dagi aniq band ko'rsatilmagan. Minimal 3 $/kg qo'llanmadi. Yo'l: 2.0 kg × 9,50 $ = 19.0 $.
